## PASTA 2.0.0

PASTA 2.0 is the Astral-menu release. It restores Lua scripting, Web Radar, Bunny Hop, and the grenade helpers that were removed from the 1.2 line, and keeps the combat, visual, walk-bot, automation, config, and loader work from 1.2.x.

### Menu and interface

- Astral-derived menu shell with the PASTA header, icon navigation, accent-aware cards, animated content changes, and the shared HUD panels.
- Top-level Aimbot, Triggerbot, Visuals, Walk Bot, Automation, Misc, and Configs pages; Automation has its own lightning-icon page.
- Walk Bot uses a stick-figure icon, and the menu header and page transitions follow the Astral presentation.
- Active binds, spectator list, watermark, and bomb information/timer use Astral panel styling.
- Configs page rebuilt around the Astral card and list design; the duplicate Configs page was removed from Misc.
- Interface surface colors update live, the white toggle flash is fixed, and overlay readability follows the live menu DPI.
- Configs and logs use the PASTA Documents folders; the embedded default profile is restored and config deletion is fixed.

### Lua API

- Sandboxed Lua 5.4 runtime, managed from **Misc → Lua API**.
- Scripts and packages live in `Documents\PASTA\scripts`; import, refresh, open the folder, enable, autoload, hot reload, and use per-script controls.
- Sandboxed scripts can read game state, draw overlays, handle events, store per-script settings, and send only game key input while CS2 is focused. Windows, Alt, Escape, Enter, console, application, and browser keys are refused.
- The bundled **Vesta Web Radar** is the verified trusted package; it can start its helper process and use network access. Every other script stays restricted to the sandbox.
- The bundled Web Radar script and radar asset are restored, and the Lua API smoke test is included at `docs/lua/pasta_api_test.lua`.

### Movement

- Bunny Hop is back under **Misc → Movement** with a configurable activation key.
- It requires CS2's jump action to be bound to a keyboard key; a mouse jump bind is rejected.
- It is off by default, pauses while Walk Bot owns movement, and stays out of a grenade lineup's crouch/run/jump sequence.
- Edge Jump is intentionally not included.

### Grenades

- Lineup Helper is back under **Misc → Grenades** with 12 maps and 1,122 lineups.
- Stand markers, aim markers, throw type, distance readouts, plaque style, and marker colors are configurable.
- Lineup Aim Assist uses Mouse5 by default, and can settle the aim and release the throw automatically.
- Lineup Helper is off by default.
- Trajectory Preview shows the held grenade's path, live grenade trails, line and bloom styling, bounce points, and the end point.
- Local Prediction Only keeps trajectory rendering to the local simulation. Trajectory Preview is off by default.

### Automation and combat

- Walk Bot keeps navigation-mesh routes and recordings, hunting, obstacle breaking, its own aim, autofire, and Auto Buy.
- Spray Mode (Beta), Rear Defense, Auto Crouch, Auto Scope, Auto Bonus Weapon, Auto Knife, and Auto Health Shot remain available.
- Auto Accept, Auto Rejoin, and Auto Disconnect remain available.
- Aimbot, RCS, Triggerbot, Auto Stop, and penetration remain available.

### Visuals and diagnostics

- Player ESP, box and bar styles, info flags, chams, skeletons and hitboxes, sound ESP, item and projectile ESP, bomb ESP, radar, tracers, hitmarkers, hit sounds, visual no-flash/no-smoke, and crosshair remain available.
- Overlay watermark, active binds, spectator list, and bomb information/timer remain available.
- Local anonymous diagnostic journal, crash record, and report remain available.

### Release

- Releases now use stable `vX.Y.Z` tags and `PASTA X.Y.Z` titles instead of build-number suffixes.
- The workflow advances the patch version automatically when the next release starts, keeping `CMakeLists.txt` and the tag in sync.

### Downloads

Download both files and keep them in the same folder:

- `pasta_loader.exe` — recommended launcher. Approve the UAC prompt, then press **Load PASTA**.
- `pasta.exe` — the assist itself. Start it this way if Counter-Strike 2 is already running.

PASTA makes no anti-cheat guarantee. Use it at your own risk.
